registered: 2026-11-09, before any holdout bar was loaded
rules: 30-minute opening range (09:30-09:59 ET). From 10:00 to 11:59, the first trade one tick through the range high (long) or low (short) enters by stop order. Stop at the other side of the range. No target. Flat at 15:59. One trade a day. Bar with both sides broken: no trade.
costs: $1/side commission, 1 tick entry/exit slippage, 3 ticks on stops; double-slippage run also reported
holdout_pass: rolling pass rate above the coin flip's mean pass rate on both accounts
holdout_strong_pass: rolling pass rate above the coin flip's 95th percentile on both accounts
